text:
sam: Quick sync after the kv eviction postmortem. We need a minimal, automatable test matrix + ownership so this doesn't keep sneaking into prod on write spikes. Ideas: short pre-deploy smoke, nightly long-run, and a targeted regression that can be run locally.

marta: I can take the regression + promptset. Will create a small dataset with hot prefixes and synthetic TTL churn. Plan: parametrize by write QPS and key cardinality. ETA: 1 week (2026-05-05).

lin: I'll own the nightly long-run and the chaos drill orchestration. Want to make the drill safe: start in a sandbox cluster, limit to one availability zone, and have automatic rollback if error rates spike above threshold. Dry-run target: 2026-05-07.

alex: I'll wire the pre-deploy smoke (fast-kv-smoke) into canary. Keep it <4 minutes and only run a tiny warmup + single eviction scenario. Also will add Jira INF-4520 to track gating decisions.

sre-bot: Note: infra quotas may be needed for nightly long-run. Please open infra request 2 days before the dry-run.

marta: Test details I'm planning to commit: 3 scenarios (low-cardinality heavy-writes, high-cardinality moderate-writes, warm-cache writes). Each scenario records p50/p95/p99, evictions/sec, cache-hit-rate. Assertion: under regression profile, p95 must not degrade >12% from baseline.

lin: Chaos drill playbook (draft):
```
- setup: provision sandbox namespace and seed keys (marta dataset)
- step1: start load generator (configurable qps)
- step2: throttle memory on one kv node (cgroup limits)
- step3: monitor: eviction log events, redis/kvs metrics, latency percentiles
- abort: if error rate > 2% for 5m -> rollback and notify oncall
- cleanup: remove throttle, validate keys intact
```
I'll add Grafana panel links to the runbook.

alex: CI snippet for pre-deploy (example):
```yaml
jobs:
  fast-kv-smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: ./scripts/run_kv_smoke.sh --mode quick --timeout 180
```
Make sure it uses a read-only token and doesn't hit prod datasets.

sam: Ownership recap: Marta=regression+promptset (INF-4520-1), Lin=nightly+chaos drill (INF-4520-2), Alex=pre-deploy smoke + ticket wiring (INF-4520-3). Can we add small success criteria for the dry-run?

marta: success criteria: 1) regression PR merged and nightly job created, 2) promptset runs in CI and reports metrics, 3) baseline measurements captured.

lin: for the dry-run: success = drill completes without >2% user-visible errors and we collect required logs/panels. If we hit the abort threshold, we treat it as a learning incident and run a remediation checklist.

alex: timeline proposal: PRs by 2026-05-05, sandbox provisioned by 2026-05-03, dry-run 2026-05-07, nightly enabled 2026-05-08. I'll update INF-4520 with these dates.

sre-bot: Created job: `kv-eviction-nightly` scheduled 03:30 UTC.

deploy-bot: Canary pipeline updated: `fast-kv-smoke` step added to canary stage.

sam: small ask: add a short note in the postmortem board linking to the new eval prompts and the baseline numbers so future triage has context.

marta: will add baseline CSV and a README in evals/regressions/kv_eviction. PR will include run instructions and how to reproduce locally with docker-compose.

lin: I'll open the dry-run channel 24h before the run and invite oncall and SRE leads.

alex: Great. If anyone slips on dates, update INF-4520. Thanks. :rocket:
